python3 << 'EOF'
import re

# 1. Content_Types.xml - add Override for slide6
ct_path = 'unpacked/[Content_Types].xml'
with open(ct_path) as f:
    ct = f.read()
if 'slide6.xml' not in ct:
    ct = ct.replace(
        '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml"',
        '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>\n  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml"'
    )
with open(ct_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(ct)
print("Content_Types updated")

# 2. presentation.xml.rels - add rId13 for slide6
rels_path = 'unpacked/ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels'
with open(rels_path) as f:
    rels = f.read()
if 'slide6.xml' not in rels:
    rels = re.sub(
        r'(<Relationship Id="rId12" Type="http://schemas\.openxmlformats\.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide5\.xml"/>)',
        r'\1\n  <Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>',
        rels
    )
with open(rels_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(rels)
print("presentation.xml.rels updated")

# 3. presentation.xml - add sldId 261 with rId13
pres_path = 'unpacked/ppt/presentation.xml'
with open(pres_path) as f:
    pres = f.read()
if 'rId13' not in pres:
    pres = re.sub(
        r'(<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>)',
        r'\1\n    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>',
        pres
    )
with open(pres_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(pres)
print("presentation.xml updated")
EOF
